t.RETINOL.agn: In the EU the limits are 0.05% in body lotion and 0.3% in other products (retinol equivalent); the label must say 'Contains vitamin A. Consider your daily intake before use' (EU 2024/996, Annex III entry 376). Non-compliant products may not be placed on the market since 1 November 2025 and may not be sold from 1 May 2027.
t.RETINOL.eff.0: Together with vitamin A from food and supplements, total intake may exceed the upper limit; this is why the EU limited the concentration and made the label warning mandatory.
t.RETINOL.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III, entry 376: Restricted substance: upper limits and conditions of use depend on the product type.
t.RETINOL.summary: A form of vitamin A used in anti-ageing products.
t.RETINOL.what: Listed in CosIng as a skin conditioning agent; used in night creams and serums for skin renewal.
